mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential recessionary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of falling INDPRO are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
